# Muhammad Ismail - Electric Bike Mechanic at Aziz Electronics

> Professional electric motorcycle, e-bike, and hybrid motorcycle mechanic located at Aziz Electronics, Saddar Bazaar, Saddar Market, Dera Ismail Khan (D.I. Khan), Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. 6+ years of hands-on technical expertise in BLDC hub motor rewinding, lithium-ion battery diagnostics & cell balancing, intelligent sine-wave controllers, complete wiring restoration, and fuel-to-electric dual-drive motorcycle conversions.

## Key Services Offered

- **BLDC Hub Motor & Mid-Drive Motor Repair**: Complete stator rewinding with high-temperature copper, hall sensor replacement (3144/41F), neodymium rotor magnet inspection and realignment, water-ingress drying, and high-speed ceramic/steel bearing replacement.
- **Lithium-Ion & Lead-Acid Battery Diagnostics**: Digital cell capacity analysis, precision resistance testing, smart BMS (Battery Management System) replacement, nickel strip spot welding, balancing of 48V / 60V / 72V packs, and range restoration.
- **Intelligent Motor Controller Troubleshooting**: Diagnosing MOSFET short circuits, hall sensor signal errors, throttle input calibration, regenerative electronic braking integration, and reverse assist wiring.
- **Hybrid Motorcycle Conversion (Petrol + Electric Dual-Drive)**: Custom fabrication and mounting that equips standard 70cc/100cc/125cc motorcycles with an electric hub motor and battery system alongside the original combustion engine, allowing zero-emission electric commuting in town and petrol switching for long journeys.
- **High-Current Wiring & Electrical Security**: Custom heavy-gauge silicone wire harnesses, anti-short automotive relays, digital LED instrument clusters, keyed ignition switches, and waterproof quick-disconnect power couplers.
- **Mechanical Tuning & Brake Optimization**: Hydraulic disc brake bleeding, e-brake motor shut-off switch adjustment, front suspension dampening, and reinforced frame mounting.
